$comment: Generated by a11y-kit registry. Do not edit.

checks.how: Every control in the accessibility tree (button, link, field, checkbox, radio, switch, combobox, slider, tab, menu item, option) has a name.
No exposed image without a name, unless it sits inside a named control and is hidden in the DOM too (Safari exposes icons Chromium drops).
Every table has column or row headers.
Every radio is inside a radio group.
Every form field gets its name from an associated label.
Every field marked aria-invalid points to a non-empty error text (aria-describedby or aria-errormessage on the field or its group).
Records each story's accessibility tree in reading order; a change shows up as a diff in review, and a stale screen-reader pass is detected from it.
A control's visible text is part of its accessible name.
Tab through the story: every stop looks different focused and blurred (outline, box-shadow, border, background).
In the Tab pass, the focused element isn't entirely under a sticky or fixed box (hit-test on five points).
calibration: Defect: sticky bar hides the focused button

checks.how: With WCAG text spacing applied, no text is clipped or overlaps.
At 200% text size, no text is clipped or overlaps.
Every focusable control in the story is reached by Tab; nothing with a pointer handler is pointer-only.
calibration: Clean: visually hidden Dismiss button (Base UI)

checks.how: Tab leaves every element; a cycle must be left by Escape or Shift+Tab.
No positive tabindex; Tab order follows the visual order.
axe's experimental rules (p-as-heading, td-has-header, table-fake-caption, label-content-name-mismatch, css-orientation-lock), switched on by name; listed for a person, never failing.
calibration: Advisory: a bold paragraph used as a heading

checks.how: In every state a story can be driven to: aria-expanded matches what is shown, IDREFs resolve, popups have the role and name aria-haspopup promises, no aria-label on generic elements, no focusable generic with its own key handlers, nothing focusable inside aria-hidden, no nested controls.
calibration: Defect: aria-expanded on a hidden popup
Defect: aria-label on a div without a role
Defect: a button inside a menu item
Clean: page aria-hidden behind a popup that holds focus (Radix)
Clean: empty open list, display:contents popup, menu named by an icon button
Clean: nested tree items, a dialog that hides the page without focus in it

checks.how: APG keyboard: comboboxes (ArrowDown, option, Escape twice, typing with no match), triggers open on Enter, tablists and radio groups move with arrows along their orientation, a dialog open on load closes on Escape.
calibration: Defect: no match removes the list but stays expanded
Defect: opens on click but not on Enter

checks.how: Focus moves into an opened popup and returns to its trigger when it closes.
calibration: Defect: Escape drops focus instead of returning it

checks.how: Tooltip and hover-card content: Escape closes it (focus stays), the pointer can move onto it, it doesn't close by itself.
calibration: Defect: tooltip that closes when the pointer moves onto it
Defect: hint that closes by itself

checks.how: Typing in a field and toggling a checkbox or switch doesn't navigate, open a dialog or move focus away (selects and radios: a person).
calibration: Clean: a field and a checkbox that change nothing else
Defect: typing moves focus to another field
Defect: toggling a checkbox opens a dialog

checks.how: With forced-colors: active, no control becomes one flat color that it isn't in normal colors (no edge, text or mark left).
calibration: Defect: controls and an icon drawn only with fills

checks.how: With forced colors, every Tab stop looks different focused and blurred, from screenshots.
calibration: Defect: controls and an icon drawn only with fills

checks.how: With forced colors, CSS mask icons don't disappear.
calibration: Defect: controls and an icon drawn only with fills

checks.how: With forced colors, a checked checkbox, radio or switch doesn't look like an unchecked one (when it differs in normal colors).
calibration: Defect: controls and an icon drawn only with fills

checks.how: Every story's play tests run again at a 360px viewport.
Animations are behind motion-safe or a reduced-motion check (AAA, recorded for the library).
The source has no CSS reordering (order-*, *-reverse, col/row-start); reordering sends the component to review.
VoiceOver + Safari, each story's checklist (what should be heard as rendered, after ArrowDown, Enter, typing); the only check for status messages.
A person reads the component, its docs and examples against the criterion; the verdict goes to the manual register.
Product level: pages, content, media and flows (titles, language, skip link, captions, consistent navigation and help, error prevention).
A fresh load at the criterion's own 320 CSS px viewport doesn't scroll horizontally; two-dimensional content (table, grid, pre, data-reflow-exempt) is exempt.
calibration: Defect: fixed-width box scrolls sideways at 320px
Clean: data table scrolls inside its own box

checks.how: In the Tab pass, focus alone doesn't change the URL or open a modal dialog (a non-modal popup that leaves focus on the field, or one the focused control owns, is content, not context).
calibration: Defect: focusing a field changes the URL
Defect: focusing a field opens a modal dialog
Clean: a combobox shows its own popup on focus

checks.how: No document- or window-level key handler matching a single printable character without a modifier check (component onKeyDown is the criterion's own exception).
Multipoint or path-based gesture handling (touches.length > 1, gesture libraries, touchmove tracking) only in files that also have a click or keyboard path.
No action fired on pointerdown, mousedown or touchstart (handlers that only prevent default, focus or set visual state pass).
Drag handling (dnd libraries, pointer capture with pointermove, draggable) only in files with a keyboard path or an input alternative.
Password inputs carry an autocomplete a password manager can use; no paste blocking in files with a password or login field.
No infinite animation cycling faster than 3 times a second that swings opacity, visibility or background (cannot measure flash area or red flashes).
No setTimeout of a second or more that closes, removes or navigates away from content unless the file can pause, extend or hold it on hover/focus.
No setInterval that advances content and no autoplay unless the file has a pause or stop control.
Fields whose type, name or id names a personal-data purpose carry an autoComplete token; email/tel fields don't turn it off.

Every configured token pair (text on surfaces, field and control borders, checked fills, icons) in every theme and product theme, from the design system's CSS: what each component inherits, before any story renders.
